description: An actual or virtual place where buyers and sellers interact, directly or through intermediaries, to trade goods or services.

identifier.description: The identifier for this specified marketplace.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, for this specified marketplace.

orderingAvailablePeriod.description: An available ordering period for this specified marketplace.

salesMethodCode.description: The code specifying a sales method, such as an auction clock or mediation, for this specified marketplace.

virtualIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this specified marketplace is virtual, such as a web-based marketplace.

websiteURIId.description: A website Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for this specified marketplace.
